hints.tr: `fig, ax = plt.subplots()` bir tuval ve bir çizim alanı veriyor.
hints.en: `fig, ax = plt.subplots()` gives you a canvas and a drawing area.
`len(ax.patches)` gives the number of bars and `ax.get_title()` the title.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.bar(data["city"], data["score"])
ax.set_title("Average score by city")
ax.set_xlabel("City")
ax.set_ylabel("Score")

print(len(ax.patches))
print(ax.get_title())
print(ax.get_xlabel())
print(ax.get_ylabel())
```
